episodes.synopsis: A princess left to die, a brother out for revenge, and a student in caught in a conspiracy.
episodes.title: The Mage in the Barrel

episodes.synopsis: Mahiro has told Yoshino to leave the city while he can, before he can Evangeline stops him and Yoshino has to make a life or death choice.
episodes.title: He Said She Was Very Beautiful

episodes.synopsis: Against Hakaze's sound advice, Mahiro continues his battle against the mage Natsumura. Hakaze has to help Yoshino save Mahiro’s life.
episodes.title: There Are Things Even Magic Cannot Do

episodes.synopsis: Just after arriving at the next town another fruit has appeared.  While waiting out the storm, Yoshino and Mahiro take shelter in an abandon house, sharing the tale on how they became friends to Hakaze.
episodes.title: The Cursed Pair

episodes.synopsis: Following the Fruit of Exodus should lead Mahiro and Yoshino to them Samon, but along the way they still must find talisman to obstruct the summing ritual.
episodes.title: Everything Happens For a Reason

episodes.synopsis: After discovering that Hakaze might be dead, Mahiro and Yoshino start to question their goal.  But before they could ask Hakaze any questions they are attacked, but not by the mages.
episodes.title: The Paradox of the Skull

episodes.synopsis: While Hakaze sleeps, Yoshino thinks back to the time he, Mahiro, and Aika spent time at their summer house looking at the stars.
episodes.title: First Kiss

episodes.synopsis: As the joint military strike begins against the barrier protecting the Tree of Exodus, Mahiro and Yoshino heads straight to the tree, but before they make it, Samon is there to greet them.
episodes.title: The Hour to Suppress the Princess

episodes.synopsis: With Hakaze dead, her usefulness has ended.  Mahiro offers the same deal he made with Hakaze for Aika killer.   Seeing that Mahiro is willing to destroy the world, Yoshino finally makes his stand.
episodes.title: Boyfriend

episodes.synopsis: Convincing Mahiro to give him a chance was the easy part.  Yoshino now has to prove the time difference is a myth in hopes of bringing Mahiro back to Hakaze’s side.
episodes.title: How to Make a Time Machine

episodes.synopsis: The mystery of the cage is solved, but how can the paradox of time travel confirmed to logic of the Tree of Genesis. Samon has underestimated Hakaze allies and knows it’s just a matter of time before all is revealed.
episodes.title: Girl of Time

episodes.synopsis: The Tree of Exodus has revived, but Hakaze is still trapped on the island.
episodes.title: Absent Thee from Felicity Awhile

episodes.synopsis: Mahiro knows he is dead, but he is at home having a conversation with Aika.  He relives the moments of his life leading up to the return of Kusaribe Hakaze and his last moments.
episodes.title: The Reason of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Mahiro has been asked to do the impossible, meanwhile Yoshino and the Princess continue to tour the land and the effects the Tree of Genesis had.  Along the way they meet a peculiar young man…
episodes.title: Happy New Year

episodes.synopsis: As Mahiro interrogates the alleged mage of Exodus, Jun meets with the Princess to question her true feelings of Yoshino.
episodes.title: You Seem to Be Plotting Something

episodes.synopsis: The mage of Exodus has finally made his flashy debut destroying a tree in front of millions. During the performance, Hakaze mind is elsewhere as information of a spy infiltrating the Kusaribe village and reporting of a ghost sends her heading home.
episodes.title: The Wandering Apparition

episodes.synopsis: Hakaze tries to learn more about Yoshino's girlfriend to talk herself out of liking him. At the same time Samon and his team are trying to determine who Yoshino’s girlfriend is.
episodes.title: Marine Snow

episodes.synopsis: From love come the birth of the Dancing Princess, but what will anger lead Mahiro to do when he finds Yoshino?
episodes.title: The Dancing Princess

episodes.synopsis: As Eva explains to Hakaze what she believes where the Trees come from, Yoshino lays it all out for Mahiro.
episodes.title: The Object of Desire

episodes.synopsis: Hakaze plans to the impossible twice and if she survives it could change Mahiro and Yoshino lives forever.
episodes.title: Whodunit (Who Did It)

episodes.synopsis: Fuwa Aika killer is...
episodes.title: Femme Fatale (Woman of Fate)

episodes.synopsis: Hakaze has explained everything to Mahiro and Yoshino and as Aika predicted, they have taken it quite well. Hanemura, on the other hand, can’t believe what he is hearing and rages.
episodes.title: Fuwa Aika

episodes.synopsis: The team assembles to take on the world’s governments and the tree.  Everything hinges on the performance of the Dancing Princess and mage of Exodus.
episodes.title: Battle of Genesis

episodes.synopsis: Aika lived according to the script of the mage of Exodus; Yoshino refuses to live by such foolishness.
episodes.title: To Each, Their Own Tale
